mapper.select: select t.*,m.DEPTID ,o.orgname as deptName from TBL_RISK_MONDICTONARY t left join TBL_RISK_MONMODEL m on m.dictonaryid=t.id and m.VERSIONID=(select id from TBL_MONMODEL_VERSION where orgid=#{orgid} and version=(select max(version) from tbl_monmodel_version where orgid=#{orgid} ) ) left join TBL_ORGANIZATION o on o.orgid=m.deptid where t.ORGID=#{orgid} order by sort
